items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: But old Ziggle walked out on us and he had a gang of cats with him too.

ctx.x: He sure did. He couldn't see us at all. Because looked like Duke was sick to go in there, It was one of those things you know. But old Ziggle walked out on us and he had a gang of cats with him too. And oh, he was a handsome looking guy, yes.
And then the next job, when you really started working was in Connie's Inn. That's when we sent for mother and I to come.
